gloss_text: Flash flood warning for your area. Move at once to higher ground, and do not drive if there is water on the road. Details at the example link.
Hi, this is Amit. Dinner has moved to eight. Call back at your leisure, there is no hurry.
Hello, I wanted to ask about the yoga studio. When are you free? No hurry, call me back later.
Son, did you buy the rice? Call when you are free, nothing urgent.
Hello, your gym membership is due for renewal next month. Please call the front desk to talk about it.
Buddy, I wanted to talk about the Saturday plans. Call when you get time, no rush.
Hello, this is a call from your dentist's clinic. Please call back to confirm your cleaning appointment next Tuesday.
Live captions are on. The Hindi language pack has finished downloading.
A call is in progress, so captions are paused for now. They will resume on their own when the call ends.
The speech model has been updated. You do not need to do anything.
Captions are on for this video. Tap to change the language.
The English language pack is downloading. Until then, captions will show in English.
Today's suggestions are ready. Tap to see tips for saving battery.

Who is coming to the tea stall on Sunday? I am bringing the cake this time 😂 Last time Rohan forgot the candles. Let us meet at six near the gate and walk over together. Kids can bring their cycles too!

[Dev] Who is on the ridge trail this weekend? The weather looks fine. Last time we lost the way after the second bridge, so we will share locations this time. Carry water and snacks. Tell us your car count so we can plan the pickup.

Lunch is booked for Thursday at one at the Thai restaurant. If anyone is vegetarian, tell me by tomorrow because I need to give the count. Anu asked if we can bring a cake for Raj's birthday and I said yes.
Just to let everyone know, next month's book is a mystery novel. Finish it by the 15th. Priya is hosting, and everyone brings their own snacks. Tell me the rest of what you want to bring.
Everyone slept late today 😴 Which movie are we watching tomorrow? If it rains the tickets get cancelled, otherwise the seven o'clock show is fixed. I will reach first and bring popcorn.
Good morning friends 🌞 May your day be full of happiness. Forward this message to 10 people and good news will come tomorrow. Do not ignore it, share now!
Forwarded by many people: tomorrow the water tanker will not come because the drivers are on strike. Share this with all neighbours so nobody is troubled. The source is unknown, but someone heard it.
Happy Friday to everyone! Want free tickets? Forward this message to 5 groups and win a prize. Fill in the form at the example link.
This is absolutely true, be sure to read it to the end 🙏 Send this beautiful good night message to all your contacts tonight. Blessings will reach you by morning. Do not break the chain.

Collect donations for Diwali decorations by Friday. Send your share to the society account and the screenshot to the secretary. Lift maintenance is from 10 to 12 on Monday, so use the stairs if you can.
Next Saturday at eight in the morning there is a park cleaning drive. Bring gloves and brooms, the society will give bags. Tea and snacks at ten. Children can come with adults.
Calendar update: the library reading circle moves to Tuesdays at six in the evening from next week. Chairs and tea will be provided. Please RSVP in the community app so we can count everyone.
Smoke is rising from the basement of Tower B. The fire brigade has been called. Everyone please come down by the stairs and gather at the playground. Do not use the lift at all.

Water is filling the basement parking in Lane 3. Stay away from the basement and move cars to the upper level if it is safe. The administration has asked people to stay away from this area until the water goes down.

A complaint of gas smell has come in. People of Building 4 should come out now and gather in the parking area. Do not use the lift at all. The fire team is coming, so stay away from the area until it is cleared.
Guest Anil Joseph is waiting at Gate 1 for Flat C-202. A cab driver is standing at Gate 3 to deliver a parcel. Approve or reject entry from the app. Visitor records are kept for 30 days.
Guest Priya Verma has reached the main gate and is waiting for your approval. Please approve or reject the entry in the app. There is no unknown person at the gate.
